subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Sanctions Evasion Techniques
description: A 60-second lesson on Sanctions Evasion Techniques.

hook.text: A ship turns off its transponder in the middle of the ocean. It's transferring oil between vessels to evade sanctions.

buildup.text: Sanctions evasion uses shell companies, front men, crypto, and dark fleet tankers to move money and goods covertly.

discovery.text: Iran operates a 'shadow fleet' of over 600 tankers that transport oil in violation of international sanctions.

twist.text: Enforcement agencies use satellite imagery, blockchain analysis, and AI to detect evasion patterns.

climax.text: Sanctions only work if enforced. Evasion is constant, making compliance a continuous cat-and-mouse game.

punchline.text: Transponder off. Ship-to-ship transfer. Sanctions evaded at sea.

quiz.question: How do sanctioned countries evade oil sanctions?
options: Using dark fleet tankers with transponders turned off
By asking the UN for exemptions
